summary: Hebrew masculine nouns usually take -im (ים), feminine nouns -ot (וֹת); the vowels of the stem often change.

askYourself: Do the stem vowels shorten (גֶּזֶר → גְּזָרִים)?

traps: The ending does not always follow the gender: דְּלַעַת (pumpkin) is feminine, yet its plural is דְּלוּעִים (-im).
The stem vowels change in the plural: גֶּזֶר → גְּזָרִים, בָּצָל → בְּצָלִים.
